The role will also involve monitoring sales team performance, ensuring timely customer follow-ups, tracking lead-to-order conversion rates, and coordinating with the sales team to improve overall sales outcomes. We are seeking someone who can connect marketing activities with measurable business results and take ownership of marketing performance in a fast-paced e-commerce environment. Mandatory Experience Requirement:  Candidates must have at least 3 years of relevant professional experience and prior work experience in an advertising agency, an established e-commerce business, or a startup company. Marketing Strategy & Planning Develop and implement marketing strategies aligned with Fish Vally's business objectives and revenue targets. Prepare monthly and quarterly marketing plans, campaign calendars, promotional strategies, and customer acquisition initiatives. Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer behavior analysis to identify growth opportunities. Develop strategies to improve brand awareness, customer acquisition, repeat purchases, and customer retention. Identify new marketing channels and opportunities to expand Fish Vally's market presence. 2. Digital Marketing & Performance Marketing Plan, execute, monitor, and optimize paid advertising campaigns on Facebook and Instagram using Meta Ads Manager. Analyze campaign performance, advertising costs, Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), Cost per Acquisition (CPA), and conversion rates. Develop effective marketing funnels to convert audiences and customer inquiries into confirmed orders. Coordinate with the creative and content teams to develop advertising videos, Reels, promotional creatives, product campaigns, and other marketing materials. Test different audiences, creatives, offers, and campaign strategies to improve advertising efficiency. Explore and manage relevant marketing opportunities across Google Ads, YouTube, and other digital platforms. Monitor marketing expenditure and ensure campaigns are focused on measurable business outcomes. 3. Sales Performance Monitoring & Follow-up Monitor the sales team's daily, weekly, and monthly performance against assigned targets. Establish a structured process for following up with prospective customers, pending orders, missed inquiries, and abandoned orders. Ensure that leads generated through marketing campaigns receive timely follow-up from the sales team. Track lead-to-order conversion rates and identify reasons for lost sales. Review sales reports and coordinate with sales executives to improve follow-up quality and conversion performance. Prepare regular reports on sales performance, lead status, conversion rates, and follow-up effectiveness. Coordinate with the sales and operations teams to align marketing campaigns with product availability and delivery capacity. Note:  The primary responsibility is marketing strategy and performance. The selected candidate will supervise sales follow-up systems and monitor team performance rather than personally handle routine customer inquiries or daily frontline sales. 4. Track key performance indicators (KPIs), including lead generation, conversion rates, ROAS, CPA, customer acquisition cost, and marketing expenditure. Analyze campaign data and recommend actionable improvements. Evaluate the effectiveness of marketing campaigns based on actual sales and business results, not only reach or engagement. Present marketing performance, challenges, and growth opportunities to management. 5. Team Coordination & Business Growth Coordinate with content creators, graphic designers, video editors, and sales executives to execute marketing plans. Set clear priorities and timelines for marketing campaigns and promotional activities. Work closely with management to establish marketing goals and growth plans. Identify opportunities to improve average order value, repeat purchases, customer lifetime value, and overall profitability. Take ownership of assigned marketing objectives and provide regular progress updates.
